[[Bohdalz the Furious]] is a [[Heket]] boss that appears in Vehtendi Valley.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Vehtendi Valley}} (not during [[Rally The Princes]])

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Spirit Rift}}
*{{skill icon|Weapon of Fury}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Wielder's Boon}}
*{{skill icon|Wielder's Remedy}}
*{{skill icon|Wielder's Strike}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Bohdalz's Fury]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
* Be extremely careful of this boss' Spirit Rift. In Normal Mode, the amount of damage this skill can do is already high, but in Hard mode, it is capable of dealing 500+ damage to each character, easily killing all of a clumped group. When he uses Spirit Rift you have 3 seconds to flag your [[hero]]es away.
* Bohdalz the Furious spawns near Jarimiya the Unmerciful. If seeking the least amount of foes possible, see the path on [[Jarimiya the Unmerciful]]'s page.
